slides.texte_overlay: 7 Laws a Man Must Never Break

1. Keep your word

If you said it, do it.
If you can't, say so early.

2. Never abandon a friend
in trouble

The hard days show who
you really are.

3. Respect your elders

Their time, their stories,
their patience.

4. Do the work nobody sees

Reputation is built
when no one is watching.

5. Never punch down

Strength protects.
It doesn't humiliate.

6. Admit when you're wrong

Fast and clean.
Then fix it.

7. Never stop learning

The day you stop growing,
you start shrinking.

I learn something every day
